The main takeaway from our work is that

the task of reading comprehension is not just about option selection but also about option elimination and we can improve the performance of reading comprehension systems by explicitly modeling this aspect.
\textit{reading} is a multi-step process and a human (or a machine) first tries to eliminate the least relevant information and then selects the most relevant one.
the current state of art model for this problem can be significantly improved by explicitly modelling the elimination-selection paradigm.
